title: Aboard the helicopter
description: On the floor of a helicopter, a young man lies on his back with both arms held up, a dressing wrapped around one forearm; another man's hand reaches in from the left to hold them there.
researchNotes: His account of this frame, given at the photograph on 2026-09-05 and revised by him on 2026-09-12, is in four recollection records, all held from the site by the family's decision of 2026-09-14 (issue #22): keep the photograph public, hold the story. The record carries only what the frame shows. The date is his estimate for the frame. No location is set: the frame is inside an aircraft and nothing in it places it. The narrative, the research leads, the decision, and why the location and photo links came off are in research/photos/vn-0157.md. The man is unnamed and not linked to a record. Ledger #33, issue #129.
